method.name: driver_get_state
method.description: What the driver keeps, from its implementation ([method DriverImplementation._get_state]); empty without an implementation.

method.name: driver_get_timetable_state
method.description: The driver's timetable and its progress, from its implementation ([method DriverImplementation._get_timetable_state]); empty without an implementation.

method.name: driver_report_order_changed
method.description: Called by the driver's implementation when the driver takes up another order; emits [signal driver_order_changed].

method.name: driver_report_timetable_changed
method.description: Called by the driver's implementation when its timetable, or how far it got through it, has changed; emits [signal driver_timetable_changed].

method.name: vehicle_get_seconds_until_departure
method.description: The seconds from [param hours] (the time of day) to the departure of the vehicle's train ([method DriverImplementation._get_seconds_until_departure]): by the timetable of its own driver, else of the first driver of its trainset with one ([code]Mechanik[/code], else [code]ctOwner[/code], [code]Event.cpp:2431-2435[/code]); 0 for a train without a timetable.

signal.name: driver_attached
signal.description: The person is a driver now: it was given its first implementation ([method driver_attach_implementation]).

signal.name: driver_freed
signal.description: The person is no driver any more: its implementation was taken ([method driver_attach_implementation] with null), or the person was freed (PersonServer).

signal.name: driver_order_changed
signal.description: The driver took up another order.

signal.name: driver_timetable_changed
signal.description: The driver's timetable, or how far it got through it, has changed.
